subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card messages not searchable — interactive card content not indexed by Feishu search

question: Which Feishu delivery contract should OpenClaw adopt for searchability: return auto-mode prose to plain messages, add an opt-in duplicate searchable fallback for cards, or document interactive-card search as a platform limitation?
rationale: The alternatives trade streaming UX against searchability and duplicate-message behavior, while current evidence does not establish a non-duplicating Feishu API solution.

options.title: Split auto and card behavior
options.body: Restore ordinary auto-mode prose to plain searchable messages while retaining explicit card mode and documenting its search limitation unless a native solution is proven.

options.title: Add opt-in fallback copy
options.body: After live tenant proof, add a plugin-owned setting that sends a searchable post or text copy and clearly warns about visible duplication.

options.title: Keep cards and document
options.body: Preserve current delivery and document that Feishu conversation search does not index interactive-card content.

recommendation.title: Split auto and card behavior
recommendation.body: Restore ordinary auto-mode prose to plain searchable messages while retaining explicit card mode and documenting its search limitation unless a native solution is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: This person revised, verified, and merged the current behavior and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether to preserve or narrow it.
